literal_meaning: চোখে সরিষার ফুল দেখা (seeing mustard flowers in the eyes)
figurative_meaning_en: being disoriented or panicked in danger
example_sentences_in_bangla: দুর্ঘটনার পর তার চোখে সরিষার ফুল দেখা যাচ্ছে।
যুদ্ধের ময়দানে সৈন্যরা সবাই চোখে সরিষার ফুল দেখছিল।
example_sentences_in_english: After the accident, he was seeing mustard flowers in his eyes, completely disoriented.
In the battlefield, the soldiers were all seeing stars, panicked and lost.
history: This idiom likely originates from rural Bengali life, where mustard fields are common, evoking imagery of disorientation similar to being overwhelmed in vast fields.
note: The input had a minor spelling variation ('ষরষে' corrected to 'সরিষার' for standard Bengali usage).
